scope: HEX8 linear eigenvalue buckling with linear-elastic prestress, valid bounded geometries, explicitly tested boundary conditions and first positive mode only; exploratory/research use.

benchmark.name: clamped solid cantilever block under uniform end-face dead compression
benchmark.geometry: rectangular prismatic HEX8 block, L=4.0, b=1.2, h=1.0
benchmark.boundary_conditions: all UX/UY/UZ fixed on x=0; x=L end face free
benchmark.preload: uniform nodal compression in UX on x=L, total P=1.0
benchmark.modes: first positive linearized tangent-instability factor and associated mode

gates.mode: finite, dominant lateral UZ and no NaN/Inf
gates.E_scaling: doubling E gives factor ratio 2.0 within 5%
gates.preload_scaling: doubling P gives factor ratio 0.5 within 5%
gates.geometry_sensitivity: doubling L gives a finite positive factor lower than the reference
gates.moderate_perturbation: finite positive factor within 10% of the level-4 reference

refinement_policy: record factors, adjacent changes, mode direction and residuals; do not require convergence to Euler and do not relabel a trend as convergence
external_oracle: desirable but not required for EXPERIMENTAL_CANDIDATE; report NOT_AVAILABLE if unavailable
excluded_scope: HEX8R, SRI, B-bar or hourglass formulations
